comments.body: The interesting common thread is that both techniques make complexity readable by choosing what not to preserve. Skeleton-Guided Edge Bundling gives up exact individual edge tracing to reveal corridors, while Image-Based Crowd Rendering gives up full per-person geometry to make a populated city feel visually present.

score_assessment.rationale: Strongly grounded in the page's comparison of abstraction trade-offs across the edge-bundling and crowd-rendering sources.

comments.body: I like that the page frames abstraction as an interpretive choice rather than just a speed hack. The skeleton paths, impostor samples, and distance-field raymarching examples all show geometry being converted into something easier to compute, but also into something with a narrower reading contract.

score_assessment.rationale: Accurately synthesizes all three source contexts and captures the page's emphasis on readable but partial representations.

comments.body: The edge-bundling case feels like the sharpest example because the loss is explicit. Once edges are pulled into shared skeleton-guided routes, the viewer gains a map of coarse connectivity but needs interaction or filtering before making claims about exact paths or direction.

score_assessment.rationale: Well grounded in the skeleton-bundling source's stated limitations and connects them directly to the topic's readability argument.

comments.body: That same caution applies to the crowd-rendering side, just with a different failure mode. Ten thousand impostor pedestrians can support the impression of urban density, but the technique is not promising that each avatar remains inspectable as a fully lit, close-up body.

score_assessment.rationale: Useful threaded reply that extends the limitation discussion to crowd impostors while staying within the documented source assumptions.

comments.body: Raymarching is a weaker but useful bridge here because it does not merely simplify an existing mesh or crowd. It shows another version of the same idea: visual space can become readable through a compact mathematical procedure, with the fragment shader reconstructing depth from distance relationships rather than stored geometry.

score_assessment.rationale: Balanced comment that reflects the page's weaker bridge claim for shader raymarching without overstating its relation to the other sources.
